releaseBlockers: Full raw payload bytes, HTTP headers, and SHA-256 checksums could not be preserved because the automation runtime exposed web retrieval rather than a raw HTTP client.
The two approved NOAA solar-wind URLs return HTTP 404 and require item-level approval before replacement.
The scheduled workflow exists only on draft PR #75 and was not dispatchable through the available GitHub connector in this run.
boxfireQA.statusStatement: Evidence uploaded to a generated-data branch, not the canonical application branch. This is not a verified production ingest.

proposals.title: Replace broken NOAA solar-wind endpoints with official summary products
proposals.why: Both approved URLs returned HTTP 404; the official SWPC summary endpoints returned timestamped magnetic-field and proton-speed values.
proposals.expectedBenefit: Restores current solar-wind inputs with small payloads and lower ingest cost.
risks: Less historical detail than one-day series
New field and unit contract required
proposals.defaultIfNoAction: Keep failed endpoints visibly failed; do not substitute candidates.

proposals.title: Add bounded GloTEC GeoJSON sandbox adapter
proposals.exactChange: Create a sandbox-only parser for the official GloTEC 2D ultra-real-time GeoJSON product with bounding-box sampling, payload-size limits, timestamps, TEC units, quality flags, and raw checksum retention.
proposals.why: The official endpoint is reachable and matches an existing candidate source, but the payload is large and was not parsed during this run.
proposals.expectedBenefit: Adds ionospheric total electron content as a distinct Earth-local channel.
risks: Assimilated-model output can be mistaken for direct measurement
Spatial sampling and missingness require care
proposals.privacyConsentImpact: Public feed is non-private; configured user-location precision must remain separately governed.
proposals.reversibility: High; isolated adapter and feature flag.

proposals.title: Add manual generated-data workflow dispatch and artifact retrieval path
proposals.exactChange: Expose a reviewable workflow-dispatch action for the evidence job on the agent-fleet branch and a connector-supported artifact retrieval step, without merging or writing generated data to main.
proposals.why: The available connector could inspect existing jobs but could not dispatch the draft-branch daily ingest, forcing a partial branch upload instead of a workflow artifact.
proposals.expectedBenefit: Allows the real Node harvester to preserve full payloads, headers, checksums, and artifacts.
risks: Workflow permissions must remain read-only for code
Manual and scheduled runs can duplicate dates
Artifact size and retention need limits
proposals.privacyConsentImpact: Approximate configured location may appear inside private artifacts and must remain configurable.
proposals.defaultIfNoAction: Continue partial reports and do not claim full raw capture or artifact upload.
